test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The workers called out / the strike because / the management acceded to / all their demands.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the phrase **"called out." **The correct phrase should be** "called off."**
 
• The phrase** "called off" **means to cancel or end something, which is appropriate in this context.
 
• The correct phrase should be** "called off the strike,"** ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The workers **called off the strike **because the management acceded to all their demands."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "all their demands,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "the management acceded to,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "The workers called out,"** – This part of the sentence contains the error and should be corrected to "called off."
